verifications.claim: Lowe's stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'stores will be closed on Sunday in observance of the Easter holiday.' (Easter April 5); R4: 'close all stores on Easter Sunday, April 5'; R5: 'Lowe's stores will be closed.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Lowe's closure on the specified date.

verifications.claim: Lowe's closes its stores on Easter Sunday to allow associates to spend the holiday with their families.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'so associates can take the day off and spend it with the people who matter most.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supports the reason for closure, with 'people who matter most' implying family on a family holiday.

verifications.claim: All Lowe's locations will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, during their regular business hours.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Doors will reopen on Monday, April 6, during normal business hours.'; R4: 'Stores will reopen the next day with regular hours.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm reopening date and regular hours.

verifications.claim: Lowe's has a consistent nationwide closure on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Lowe’s will close all stores on Easter Sunday'; 'seventh year in a row'; R1: spokesperson confirms closure.
verifications.reasoning: 'All stores' indicates nationwide, and 'seventh year' shows consistency.
